hints.title: Coordinate Set Tracking
hints.text: Coordinate values are between 1 and 100, which is extremely compact.

hints.title: Direct Interval Marking
hints.text: For each interval [start, end], mark all integers x in start..end as occupied.

hints.title: Set Cardinality
hints.text: The count of distinct occupied integers gives the total number of points covered.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct coordinate marking with maximum coordinate 100.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct hash set is already optimal and linear in total interval coverage.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(M) memory for occupied coordinate set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use coordinate set or difference array to count occupied points.
